content.title: Pint of Guinness to get more expensive from April
content.summary: The price of Guinness and Smirnoff will rise in pubs from 1 April after drinks giant Diageo confirmed its wholesale prices are going up.  The cost of Guinness Draught will rise by 5.2%, around 4p a pint, while the list price of a standard bottle of 70cl Smirnoff will go up by 13p.  Tequila brand Casamigos, Baileys, Guinness 0.0, Guinness Microdraught and Guinness Draught in Can will not be affected.
